description: Deactivates and permanently deletes a Sentry organization member by using a SCIM PATCH operation to set their 'active' attribute to 'false'.

Operations.description: A list of SCIM PATCH operations. For this action, must contain one operation setting the member's 'active' attribute to 'false', which deactivates and permanently deletes the member.

items.description: Request schema for individual SCIM PATCH operations.

op.description: The operation type; for this action, it must be 'replace'.
op.title: Op

path.description: The JSON Pointer path to the attribute to be modified; must be 'active'.
path.title: Path

value.description: The value for the operation. Must be `false` (boolean) to deactivate a member.
value.title: Value

items.title: OperationsRequest

Operations.title: Operations

member_id.description: The ID of the organization member to update.
member_id.title: Member Id
